title: The Impatient Loop
story: count_even() only ever looks at the first number.
goal: Diagnose the bug, then fix the code so every check passes.
hints: How many times does the loop body run before return?
Look at the indentation of return.
socratic: What did you expect it to do?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what was the bug, and how did you fix it?
alt:
def count_even(nums):
    return len([n for n in nums if n % 2 == 0])

parrot.says: Squawk! I return as soon as I know the answer. Efficient!

diagnose.question: What makes the loop stop after one item?
options: return is inside the loop, so it runs on the first pass
diagnose.why: A return inside the loop ends the whole function. Return after the loop finishes.
